source_text: Further debate involves cultural relativism, where some anthropologists contend that universal condemnation ignores contextual benefits communities attribute to FGM, such as enhanced marriage prospects, potentially alienating participants from reform efforts; however, empirical data consistently affirm no health benefits and severe long-term harms like obstetric fistula and psychological trauma. [95] [96]
